_about: Decisions about companies created from recall notices (vettingMethod automated_recall), from an AI review on 2026-10-01. Applied by scripts/classify-recall-firms.ts; read by scripts/match-recalls.ts. merged: firm id -> existing company it is the same business as (its recalls move there; the firm record is deleted). aliases: names of merged firms, treated as names of that company when matching recalls. roles: businessRole per company (null = not determined). parents: firm id -> parent company. owns: brands a recalling firm owns or owned, so its recalls naming them link as owner_brand. firmPicks: a recalling-firm name (exactly as written in notices) that matches several of our companies, mapped to the one to use. Related dba pairs were settled on 2026-10-01 by making the trade-name company a child of the legal entity (backup: review_backup.dba_parent_plan).
